text:
Morgan: Preflight check — rolling release tonight 01:00-03:00 UTC. Strategy: slice-by-slice (US -> EU -> APAC). Start with a 3% canary in us-west-2, then expand to 10% slices if green. Need thumbs on capacity and any emergency pin hooks. @deploy-bot start canary when ready
deploy-bot: Scheduling canary rollout for service=runtime, target_version=v2.4.1, slice=us-west-2, ramp=3%
Priya: us-west-2 warm pool 92% ready, spare cpu headroom ~28%. Good for 3% canary. I can keep an eye on warmup metrics.
Kevin: eu-central1 warm pool at 69% currently. We can borrow 4 nodes from standby but that reduces our cold cushion for backfill. Recommend holding EU until we confirm first-canary stabilizes.
Anjali: apac-syd nodes are cold — warm ETA for 6 nodes ~22m. Network priming still in progress. Prefer to put APAC last and give it a 30m pre-warm.
Mei: quick perf smoke from canary staging: 150 rps for 15s -> p95=130ms, p99=410ms, memory stable. No crashes.
deploy-bot: smoke results:
```
[canary-smoke] duration=15s load=150rps
p50=26ms p95=129ms p99=409ms
errors=1/2250 (0.04%)
kvcache_hit=92%
```
ops-oncall: FYI we had a transient leader election in eu-central2 earlier; keep an eye on db-latency for the next 10m after EU slices go live.
Morgan: Proposal: Begin US canary now. Hold EU until we hit >=72% warm in eu-central1 and 10m stable metrics. Schedule APAC warmup now, aim to cut APAC slice after 30m if warm. Rollback thresholds: sustained error-rate >0.8% for 4m OR p95 jump >200ms vs baseline for 3m. Any objections?
Priya: +1. I'll set a dashboard watch and tag on-call alerts.
Kevin: Add an auto-pin for EU after the canary passes (pin to v2.4.1 for 20m) so we can validate before full roll. Also set a deploybot hook to freeze expansion if cold-start errors >0.2%
Anjali: I'll trigger APAC pre-warm now and post ETA updates. If warmup misses target in 25m we abort APAC and keep traffic on US/EU.
deploy-bot: Canary initiated in us-west-2 at 4123460015. Monitoring hooks enabled.
deploy-bot: Canary 60s snapshot -> errors=0.1%, p95 delta=+9ms, ephemeral queues normal
Mei: Running a quick latency histogram check; no tail regressions so far.
ops-oncall: Posting rollback commands to runbook:
```
# rollback instantaneous for a region
deploybot rollback --service runtime --region eu --version previous-stable --reason "latency/regression"
# global pin to previous
deploybot pin --service runtime --version previous-stable --scope global
```
Priya: Also setting alert rule: if 5m error-rate >0.8% OR 3m user p95 +200ms -> auto-hold expansion and page #incidents.
Morgan: Final call: US canary proceeding. EU follows when >=72% warm and 15m stable. APAC pre-warm go; cut only if warm target met. Documented in release notes: timebox APAC to 45m total or abort. :white_check_mark:
Anjali: Updating release doc and runbook now. I'll post warmup progress here every 5m.
deploy-bot: Canary health at 4123460058 -> stable. No automatic rollback triggered.
Morgan: Great work. Keep posting live signals. If anyone sees anomalous spikes ping @ops-oncall and #incidents.
